notes: Quick one-shots / cheap iterations. M0 STATIC disable — the base minus {basic-memory} (24 servers) is enumerated in `static_disable` and applied by codex-invoke as `-c mcp_servers.<x>.enabled=false` OVERRIDES at launch, so NO live read is needed and --print-command stays fully offline (spec §2e). The disables live in scope.static_disable — NOT as transport-less `mcp_servers` lines in exec-fast.config.toml: codex rejects a standalone config whose mcp_servers entry carries no transport ('invalid transport'), so that shape cannot load; a -c override rides on the transport-carrying base server and disables it. static_disable is authored against mcp-manifest.json; the CI config-lint asserts it equals base − mcp_allowlist so it cannot silently rot, and the invoker fails CLOSED if it is ever empty (would run unscoped). Empty skills_allowlist ⇒ runs in-place (all skills). Accept that a future base-added server is not auto-disabled (choose M1 if the base drifts).
